subject: delta(client): WF check a held fence in the scope that took it and run the work in the caller's context
note: holdFence keeps the async scope that acquired the fence on its held frame. A pass made inside run() enters that scope only for the fence's ownership check and runs its work back in the caller's own context, so the caller's journal lane lock and other async-local values stay visible. Any pass inside the held frame may use the fence's capability; the capability presented outside run() is still refused tp1_fence_not_owned, and run() after release() is refused tp1_fence_not_owned without signing.
